title: Remulla dismisses claims Romualdez left jail as ‘chismis’
summary: MANILA, Philippines—Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Thursday dismissed as “chismis” (gossip) allegations that former House Speaker Martin Romualdez had been allowed to leave his detention…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Thursday dismissed as “chismis” (gossip) allegations that former House Speaker Martin Romualdez had been allowed to leave his detention facility, urging the media to review the closed-circuit television (CCTV) footage. “Chismis lang yan. I would like all of you to join me and view the CCTV footage for the entire duration na nandoon siya,” Remulla told reporters on Thursday. (That’s just gossip. I would like all of you to join me in reviewing the CCTV footage covering the entire time he was there.) Read: Ramon Tulfo admits error in Romualdez exposé He also maintained that […]...
